findings.explanation: The canonical SPL fails at parse time (non-streaming commands inside multisearch), and the LCM endpoints are unconfirmed. 'Verified' implies the search was run against real data, which it cannot have been in this form.
findings.suggested_fix: Downgrade the status until the SPL has been fixed and run against a lab cluster.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: The nutanix:host leg of the multisearch ends in `stats dc(hvk) ... by cluster_uuid`, and the upgrade_history leg uses `sort 0 - _time | dedup cluster_uuid`. multisearch requires every subsearch to be purely streaming, so the whole search errors and returns nothing. Move the per-host aggregation and latest-history selection after the multisearch (the stats latest(eval(...)) block can already handle it), or use append for those legs.

`sort 0 - severity_bucket, cluster_name` sorts the bucket names as text in descending order (ok, medium, low, high, critical), so critical and high clusters land at the bottom of the alert table. Add a numeric rank (for example eval sev_rank=case(severity_bucket="critical",4,...)) and sort on that.

The search starts with a `comment(...)` macro placed before the generating `| multisearch` command. Splunk documents that comments placed before a generating command can produce errors or incorrect results. Use triple-backtick comments after the first command, or drop the macro.

The ncc_older fallback `tostring(ncc_version)<tostring(min_ncc_version)` compares versions as text ('4.10' sorts before '4.6'), and the `failed_check_count<8` cap means eight or more failed NCC checks produce no precheck warning at all.

summary: The governance design (per-cluster targets, an AOS support catalogue, N-minus policy, a 24-hour mixed-AHV rule and freeze demotion) is solid and Nutanix-specific. The SPL as written will not run, though: multisearch rejects the non-streaming stats, sort and dedup subsearches, and the final sort puts critical rows last. The schedule in the savedsearches fragment contradicts the stated five-minute cadence, one validation search is meaningless, and 'verified' status is claimed for a search that was never run. The description, value, KFP and controlTest fields are template residue, and the equipment tags are padded.
